scenarios.name: a closed survey is frozen, and an existing survey's anonymity cannot be flipped

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_surveys__surveys (id, title, status, anonymous, created_by, created_at, closed_at) VALUES ('s_open', 'Open one', 'open', 1, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', NULL), ('s_closed', 'Closed one', 'closed', 0, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-03T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_surveys__surveys SET title = 'Rewritten' WHERE id = 's_closed'
UPDATE app_surveys__surveys SET anonymous = 0 WHERE id = 's_open'
UPDATE app_surveys__surveys SET title = 'Open one, renamed' WHERE id = 's_open'
SELECT id, title, anonymous FROM app_surveys__surveys
